title: Van Klaveren vs Sybille — European Lightweight Title, Rotterdam 1931
video_credit: Polygoon Hollands Nieuws, week 21 1931 — public domain, via Wikimedia Commons (File:Bokswedstrijd.webm)

markets.question: Who wins the title fight?
markets.reveal_text: Dark trunks raises his arms. Van Klaveren is European champion!

markets.question: Does the crowd storm the ring after the fight?
markets.reveal_text: Hats in the air. Officials and fans pack the ring.

markets.question: Replay incoming: will we see a fighter hit the canvas?
options: No, it stays on their feet
markets.reveal_text: Down he goes. Light trunks hits the canvas and the referee starts counting.

markets.question: Closing shot: does the champion wave to the camera?
markets.reveal_text: A wave for the newsreel cameras.
